g.text: Writer and independent checker: extracted component dependencies
Neutral JSON, bytes and check ledger
Solid arrow: extracted static dependency (a class of one component refers to a class of the other).
Dashed arrow: declared data flow through a file; no code connects the two modules.
Grey boxes: shared JSON, byte and check-ledger code used across their module (incoming arrows omitted).
Not drawn: Native inventory tools, Prototype candidate support.
Every arrow and omission is listed in component-view.md with its class pairs.
